info.name: Karigor API
info.description:
Every endpoint of the Karigor API (see docs/05-api.md), as one story you can run from top to bottom:
a customer signs up, checks a problem, books a technician, the technician does the job,
the customer reviews it, and the admin manages people and the catalog.

Before running, open the collection Variables tab and fill in:
- baseUrl: http://localhost:4000/api/v1 for a local server (npm run dev), or the deployed API
- adminPhone and adminPassword: ADMIN_PHONE and ADMIN_PASSWORD from server/.env
- testUserPassword: TEST_USER_PASSWORD from server/.env (the seeded test accounts)

The database must be seeded (npm run seed -w server). Use AI_MODE=mock to keep AI checks free.
Tokens, ids and the booking time are saved into variables by the test scripts as you go,
so run the folders in order (or use Run collection).
